class.name: AgentWait
class.brief_description: Emits [signal done] when an [AgentTest] wait finishes.
class.description: Returned (as its [signal done] signal) by the waits of [AgentTest]. Not meant to be created directly.

signal.name: done
signal.description: Emitted when the wait finishes. [param value] is [code]false[/code] if a [method AgentTest.signal_or_timeout] wait timed out, otherwise [code]true[/code].
